evidenceBoundary: Token Table is a six-seat simulated-token poker companion; it has no token import/parser/search/filter/export UI. The browser suite exercises the shipped demo and the compiled HTML through the real sandboxed ExtensionHost. Its host service fixture is deterministic and local, verifies exact HTTP bridge requests and realtime publication, and does not prove a live sidecar, multiplayer peer, or monetary/quota behavior.
